trap.label: estratégia de leitura
trap.wrong: The text says that the author is agree, but it don’t say it.
trap.right: The text says that the author agrees, but it doesn’t say it.
trap.why: Em português “concorda” é verbo; o brasileiro usa to be + agree. Em inglês, agree é verbo e o auxiliar negativo da 3ª pessoa é doesn’t.

mcq.q: True/False/Not Given: if the text doesn’t mention it, answer…

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no plural: “The writer says that.” (The writers)
